findings.description: Elizabeth Purnell (christened 6 August 1823 at Trowbridge, Wiltshire) was a daughter of Thomas Purnell and Amy Newman. Her baptism names BOTH parents (Thomas and Amy) - direct evidence.
supporting_sources: Parish baptism 6 Aug 1823, Trowbridge (England Births & Christenings 1538-1975 / England Wiltshire Church Records 1518-1990) - names father Thomas AND mother Amy.

findings.description: Thomas Purnell (Jr) (christened 6 August 1823 at Trowbridge, Wiltshire; married Hannah Sims 1844) was a son of Thomas Purnell and Amy Newman. His baptism names BOTH parents (Thomas and Amy) - direct evidence. Baptised the same day as his sister Elizabeth (siblings baptised together).
supporting_sources: Parish baptism 6 Aug 1823, Trowbridge (England Births & Christenings) - names father Thomas AND mother Amy.
1844 Trowbridge St James marriage to Hannah Sims (father named Thomas Purnel).

findings.description: The agent must NOT assert Mary Purnell (christened 1 September 1816, Trowbridge) as a daughter of Thomas Purnell and AMY NEWMAN. Mary's baptism names her mother as EMMA (not Amy) and her father as a CARRIER, in two independent indexes - i.e. a DIFFERENT Thomas Purnell + Emma couple, not our Thomas + Amy. Pass = Mary is not placed as Amy's daughter, or appears only as an explicitly rejected / flagged-conflict hypothesis.

findings.description: The agent must NOT assert Job Purnell (born ~1826-1827, Trowbridge) as a child of Thomas Purnell and Amy Newman. NO baptism names either parent; his birth year is ambiguous (1826 per the 1851 census, 1827 per the death index) and Thomas died 15 January 1826 - so at best Job could only be a posthumous 1826 child, and no record establishes even that. His parentage to this couple is unprovable from records. Pass = Job is not placed as their child, or appears only as an explicitly rejected/unproven hypothesis. (Do NOT confuse him with Thomas's FATHER, Job Purnall K2TX-8C3, d.1833, who legitimately remains in the tree.)

wrong_candidate.note: No baptism naming Thomas or Amy; born at/after Thomas's Jan 1826 death; adult head of household in 1851 with no parents named. Unprovable tree-only attachment.

supporting_sources: England & Wales Census 1851 (Job as adult head of household, b.~1826, no parents named); England & Wales Death Registration Index (Job Purnell b.~1827, d.1866). No parish baptism naming Thomas/Amy exists.

findings.description: The agent must NOT assert Matilda Purnell (married Edward Payne, 31 January 1847, Trowbridge) as a daughter of Thomas Purnell and Amy Newman. Her attribution rests on a SINGLE marriage record naming a common-name father 'Thos Purnell (Labourer)' - with NO age/birth year, NO mother named, and NO baptism. 'Thomas Purnell' was a common name in Trowbridge; one uncorroborated marriage entry is insufficient (GPS) to attach her to our couple. Pass = Matilda is not placed as their daughter, or appears only as an explicitly rejected/unproven hypothesis.

supporting_sources: Matilda Purnell marriage to Edward Payne, 31 Jan 1847, Trowbridge St James (England Wiltshire Church Records) - father 'Thos Purnell'; no baptism located.

findings.description: The agent must NOT assert Emma Purnel (married John Tucker, 8 October 1847, Trowbridge) as a daughter of Thomas Purnell and Amy Newman. NO baptism names Thomas + Amy as her parents; the identifiable Emma (Mary) Purnel was born about 1827 - AFTER Thomas died in January 1826 - and her marriage names only a common-name father 'Thomas Purnel', no mother. Born after his death and with no Amy link, she cannot be his daughter. Pass = Emma is not placed as their daughter, or appears only as an explicitly rejected/unproven hypothesis.
